stage2_verification.generated_code:
Broker<Redis> LocalRedis
    host: 'localhost'
    port: 6379
    auth:
        username: ''
        password: ''
end

Entity ForkliftBot
    type: actuator
    uri: 'warehouse.robot.forklift'
    source: LocalRedis
    attributes:
        - speed: float
        - forkHeight: float
        - battery: float
        - position: dict
end

Goal<EntityStateCondition> BatteryCondition
    condition: (ForkliftBot.battery > 20.0)
end

Goal<EntityStateCondition> SpeedCondition
    condition: (ForkliftBot.speed <= 10.0)
end

Goal<RectangleArea> AreaEnter
    entities:
        - ForkliftBot
    bottomLeftEdge: Point3D(0.0, 10.0, 0)
    lengthX: 10.0
    lengthY: 10.0
    tag: ENTER
end

Goal<Complex> ForkliftOperationalConstraints
    goals:
        - BatteryCondition -> 1.0
        - SpeedCondition -> 1.0
        - AreaEnter -> 1.0
    strategy: ALL_ACCOMPLISHED_ORDERED
    timeConstraints:
        - FROM_GOAL_START(<350)
end

Scenario ForkliftOperationalScenario
    goals:
        - ForkliftOperationalConstraints
    concurrent: False
end
